theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : UpperHalfPlane → ℂ) (E : UpperHalfPlane → ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)), HeckeEis.IsEichlerIntegral n h E → ∀ (r : ℕ), r ≤ n → ∀ τ : UpperHalfPlane, HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => MvPolynomial.eval (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else -z) ((fun p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ => MvPolynomial.pderiv (1 : Fin 2) p)^[r] (E (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z)).val)) (if r = n then (Nat.factorial n : ℂ) * h τ else -MvPolynomial.eval (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else -(τ : ℂ)) ((fun p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ => MvPolynomial.pderiv (1 : Fin 2) p)^[r + 1] (E τ).val)) (τ : ℂ)
theorems.natural_summary: Applies the accepted moving-evaluation derivative, line-power evaluation, and homogeneous nilpotence lemmas, then separates the cases r = n and r ≠ n.
